activePlots.summary: Cassia served the Shattered Empire and was made a Count on day 960. The Empire now holds most of the region. On day 1040 its envoy offered Varrowgate a governorship if it helps take the last Free Coast towns.

previousBulletins: Brightwater has opened its gates to the Shattered Empire. The town's council called it a negotiated settlement; the legion outside its walls called it Tuesday.
